title: Minimax Theorem (merged into Von Neumann Minimax)
body_html:
Minimax Theorem (merged)

This node was merged. The content that used to live at zero_sum.minimax.minimax_theorem is now part of Von Neumann Minimax Theorem. See [#51] for the merge rationale.

If you arrived here from an old bookmark, a saved link, or a cross-document reference, please update it to point at zero_sum.von_neumann_minimax.

The Von Neumann minimax theorem for finite two-player zero-sum games is formalised in Lean as MatrixGame.minimax_theorem and is documented at Von Neumann Minimax Theorem. The Dantzig ordered-field route that used to be cross-listed here is tracked at Ordered-Field Minimax Statement.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 2, Thm. 2.3.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Original source of the merged minimax theorem statement.
